hand_identity: temporal Track-0 / Track-1; not anatomical left/right
normalization: wrist-relative XYZ divided by mean wrist-to-MCP XY distance
motion_features: first-order difference of normalized XYZ; zero when current or previous hand is missing
temporal_resampling: uniform selection of 32 indices over the original sequence timeline
important_note: Trainability threshold is provisional. L5 validation does not permanently remove videos.
